jobPostingInfo.jobDescription:
TransUnion's Job Applicant Privacy Notice

Team Overview

The Privacy Operations team supports data privacy compliance across TransUnion's Global Capability Centres and partners with business, legal, technology, and operational teams to embed effective privacy practices. The team helps enable the responsible use of personal data by applying TransUnion's Privacy Framework and relevant policies, standards, and controls. This role reports to the Manager II, Privacy Operations.

This is a remote position which may require occasional in-person attendance at work-related events at the discretion of management.

Role Overview And Core Responsibilities

  • Assess new and existing operational activities and processes against applicable global privacy laws and regulatory requirements, including the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA), Protection of Personal Information Act (POPIA), and comparable frameworks. 
  • Prepare and support privacy risk assessments, including Privacy Impact Assessments (PIAs), and evaluate the cross-border implications of new initiatives. 
  • Monitor
